model_level: ngspice built-in LEVEL=1 MOS models; not a foundry PDK.
signal_path: A single SPICE transient repeats forward/error/backward/accumulate/apply guide phases. Hidden and readout weight capacitors persist inside the deck between samples; only temporary activation, error, delta, and gradient caps are reset.
interpretation: This moves beyond isolated one-sample netlists: the same transistor-level loop trains on two sequential samples with persistent weight capacitors in one ngspice transient. It is still a tiny binary/regression smoke test, not a multi-class MNIST network.
